notes.title: 0.11.2 - Smoother UI, Death Screen, Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Improvements


Joystick improvements: Decrease Deadzone.
Scoreboard: Improvements with loading, error messages
Death Screeen: Redesign death screen.
Level Preview: Improve animations.
Level Complete: Solid background added.
Fonts: Use new font with lowercase characters for larger text blocks.
Roadblocks: Fix roadblock unblocked radio dialogue not showing in some cases.


Fixes

 Omit FeatureFlags from build: Remove ability to edit any of game's levels.. (Whoops)

notes.title: 0.11.0 - New levels, The Big QOL Update.
notes.notes:
Changelog for Version 0.11.0

Added

New Levels: A new set of levels for Sector 1 and 2.
UI Overhaul: Redesigned UI and HUD with centered, limited camera. 
Electrical System 2.0: Added sockets to the electrical system.
New Visuals: Added new fonts and an art pass.
Overworld: New lighting and improved truck handling.
Remastered Tracks: Updated audio tracks. 
Feedback: Haptic feedback, play audio when UI is interacted with.
Level Complete Screen: Shows both old and new report cards.  
Settings: Improved settings menu, option to opt-out of high-score uploading.


Improved

Hold to Undo: Spamming keys no more.
Play mode from Level Editor: Added a "Play" button, plus shortcuts to the Level Editor.


Have fun!
